description.en: A 172.8 km motorway in southwestern Bulgaria running Sofia–Pernik–Blagoevgrad–Kresna–Kulata, from the capital to the Greek border on Pan-European Corridor IV (European route E-79). Its lots opened between 2013 and 2024; the Kresna Gorge bypass (Lot 3.2) was still under construction as of 2026.

detail.en: State budget. In 2019 the government committed up to 741.07 million leva for the whole of Lot 3.2 Krupnik – Kresna, then planned for partial Cohesion Fund co-financing under Operational Programme Transport and Transport Infrastructure 2014–2020. The EU money was lost through delays (Ilinden Press, 2026).
detail.ro: Bugetul de stat. În 2019 guvernul s-a angajat să asigure până la 741,07 milioane de leva pentru întregul lot 3.2 Krupnik – Kresna, prevăzut atunci pentru cofinanțare parțială din Fondul de coeziune prin Programul Operațional Transport și Infrastructură de Transport 2014–2020. Fondurile UE s-au pierdut din cauza întârzierilor (Ilinden Press, 2026).
